name: Scrambler’s Gift (Heritage)
body:
You know how to climb exceptionally well.

Prerequisite(s): Climb 4 ranks, and claw natural attack and/or aberration, fey, magical beast, monstrous humanoid, ooze, or undead type and/or earth, giant, or reptilian subtype.

Benefit(s): You gain a climb speed equal to 1/2 your land speed. If you already have a climb speed, it instead improves by 10 ft.
